verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents 760+/764 prebuilt "pieces" (integrations) that let users move data between apps without code, and is positioned as an open-source Zapier alternative built around this integration marketplace. However, the story specifies 'thousands' of integrations, while evidence only shows ~760-764, and there's no independent corroboration of integration quality/maintenance beyond vendor docs (community comment even questions ease of extending the ecosystem). Missing for 10: evidence of thousands (not hundreds) of integrations, independent/third-party verification of integration breadth and vendor maintenance quality.
